Celebrations

Pear cheese cup

Pohárkrém

8 months+ Adjusted 15 min 2 portions

From 8 months. Use pasteurized dairy only. If milk is new, try the first taste in the morning on a well day, then keep offering milk foods a few times a week once tolerated.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 80 g pasteurized cottage cheese (unsalted and unsweetened)
  • 40 g plain pasteurized yogurt (loosens the cup)
  • 40 g ripe pear (peeled and cooked until soft)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Peel and core the pear and cook it in a spoon of water until soft.
  2. Mash the pear and let it cool.
  3. Stir the cottage cheese and yogurt together until loose.
  4. Fold in the pear.
  5. Spoon into a cup and serve with nothing on top.

Adjusted

Sugar and sweets on top are the usual extra, and they are not needed.

Serve pasteurized cottage cheese, yogurt, and a little cooked pear in a cup. Add no sugar and no sweets on top.
